messages.content: the map background shall exand below the chat input

Done. The pieces were already half-wired on disk (the JS `map-mode` toggles existed in `showMap`/`showChat`/`showDashboard`/`openFile`); the missing piece was the CSS. I added it at `crs-brain/public/index.html:46`:

```css
.col.center.map-mode .composer-wrap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;background:transparent;pointer-events:none}
.col.center.map-mode .composer-wrap > *{pointer-events:auto}
```

How it works: in map view the composer is pulled out of the flex flow and floated over the bottom, so `#contentArea` (and the map iframe inside it) now stretches full-height down to the bottom edge — the galaxy background fills the area **behind and below the chat input**. The composer-wrap padding is transparent and click-through (`pointer-events:none`), so you can still pan/drag the map in that strip, while the input box and its controls stay interactive. Only map view is affected; chat/dashboard/file views strip the class.

Reload the app to see it.
